name: missing_info
description: The first message leaves out whether income is after tax and the credit card's APR and minimum payment, so the agent must ask. The answer completes the profile.

turns.text: I make about $4,000 a month from my job. Rent is $1,200 a month and I spend $250 a month on groceries. I also have a credit card with a $3,000 balance.
That $4,000 is after tax. The credit card APR is 24% and the minimum payment is $90 a month.
